title: Glowing book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fff9c4' stop-opacity='0.85'/>

      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffcc00' stop-opacity='0'/>

    <linearGradient id='pageR' x1='1' y1='0' x2='0' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fffbe8'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffe9a8'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='44' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <path d='M14 32 Q30 26 48 30 L48 78 Q30 74 14 80 Z' fill='#c0392b'/>

    <line x1='23' y1='42' x2='42' y2='41'/>
